questions.text: Describe a competition you took part in.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a competition you took part in. You should say: what kind of competition it was; when and where it took place; how you prepared for it; and explain how you felt about taking part.

questions.text: Would you like to take part in a competition like this again?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you like to take part in a competition like this again?

Thank you. We've been talking about a competition you took part in, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all competitions. Why do people enjoy competitions?

questions.text: Do you think competitions on television are good entertainment?

questions.text: Is it more important to win or to take part?

questions.text: Is competition between students good or bad for learning?

questions.text: Should schools give prizes to the best students?
